# SKG ENTERPRISES

> SKG ENTERPRISES is a premier digital engineering firm, custom software company, and AI automation consultancy founded by Shreekrishna Ghimire. Headquartered in Bhainsepati, Lalitpur, Bagmati Province, Nepal (27.6588° N, 85.3082° E), SKG Enterprises delivers modern web applications, intelligent automation systems, and enterprise software for organizations across Nepal and worldwide.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: SKG ENTERPRISES
- **Founder & Principal Engineer**: Shreekrishna Ghimire
- **Headquarters**: Bhainsepati, Lalitpur, Bagmati Province 44700, Nepal
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 27.6588° N, 85.3082° E
- **Official Website**: https://ghimireshreekrishna.com.np
- **Official Email**: prabinghimire2065@gmail.com
- **Operating Philosophy**: "Turning Ideas into Technology for a Better Tomorrow" (विचारहरूलाई प्रविधिमा बदल्दै, उन्नत भविष्यको लागि). Transparent milestone-based billing, zero vendor lock-in, and production-grade engineering.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Web & Cloud Architecture**: High-speed, responsive, server-rendered and single-page applications built on React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern cloud platforms with WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and international SEO.
- **AI Automation & Intelligent Workflows**: Grounded LLM systems, generative assistant integration, document comprehension pipelines, and business workflow automations.
- **Custom Business Portals & ERP**: Tailored operational tools, inventory trackers, multi-branch management systems, and VAT/TDS compliance engines tailored for Nepal and international regulations.
- **Mobile Application Engineering**: Native-feel cross-platform mobile experiences for iOS and Android with offline-first local synchronization.
- **Interactive Concept Lab**: R&D prototypes addressing regional challenges, including Mountain Logistics Telemetry and Nepal Inland Tax ledgers.
